name: Articulated Tabletop Studio Art Easel
title: Articulated Tabletop Studio Art Easel
tagline: Ratcheting 0°–85° tilt mast + quick-lock canvas clamp jaws + 2020 aluminum extrusion spine + knurled M5 brass knobs
description: Commercial beechwood and anodized studio tabletop easels cost $165–$215 for basic tilt hinges and sliding canvas blocks. This DIY alternative combines 6 rigid PETG/PLA+ printed brackets and ratcheting quadrants with a $7.90 2020 V-slot aluminum extrusion spine and McMaster-Carr M5 brass knurled thumb hardware for $27.40 total.

engineeringNotes: Print PRT-01 (Base Hub), PRT-02 (Ratchet Hinge), and PRT-04 (Upper Clamp Jaw) in PETG with 4 perimeter walls and 35% gyroid infill for high clamping stiffness.
All T-slot sliding rails include a 0.25mm lateral clearance so carriages glide smoothly along the 2020 aluminum profile without binding.
All 6 printed STL parts (8 total items including ×3 knobs) pack onto 1 single 256×256mm Bambu Lab A1 build plate with zero support material.
